system.description: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.z1ecx6kweubsvogl]{Otherworldliness} cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you may cast the spell @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.i4ejucvglhqpfm57]{Fog Cloud} once per long rest. At 5th level, you may cast @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.36x8lw8mhfigm7ti]{Enthrall} once per long rest. You do not require material components for these spells, and your spellcasting modifier is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, whichever is highest.
